title: hank-limits: analytic-limit and aggregate-identity tests for HANK codes
description:
Tests that a HANK code must pass at limits with known answers, reported as errors and observed convergence orders. Reference implementation on sequence-jacobian 1.0.0, with minimal reproductions of two observations about that library (F1, F2). Not peer reviewed.

AI use: Developed with extensive assistance from Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) and reviewed with GPT 6.1 Sol (OpenAI); the author directed and reviewed the work and is responsible for the content.
